object.attr: as implemented: mapped from the existing tests, with blind tests written from the requirements alone for what they missed.
object.description: Read a manifest whose outline holds ref DOC-0 with ref DOC-1 nested inside it. Remove DOC-1 by moving it to the top level, and separately by deleting it, and look at DOC-0's ref. Set the outline flat with DOC-1 before DOC-0; nest DOC-1 under DOC-0; nest three levels deep; append a ref by hand. Expected: the outline reads DOC-0 then DOC-1; DOC-0's ref is written as an empty element once its only child is gone; each outline set reads back with the same order and nesting; the appended ref comes last.
